title: Madrileno Chicken Stew
description: A hearty Spanish stew originating from Madrid, made with tender chicken and a rich vegetable broth.

ingredients.name: radiant
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality Spanish olive oil

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, salt, and black pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
